description: An overview of kody-os and how apps are added.

files.index.html:
kody-os is a minimal shared OS shell. The home page shows your live widgets; the Apps page lists installed apps and opening one shows its live state, and every action runs through the same handler the agents use.

Adding apps

Copy this prompt into a Kody-connected agent and fill in the bracketed parts. Install a shipped app from the App Store — no agent needed. For a custom app, the agent adds it with MCP add_app — a registry write, no republish.

Add a new app to my hosted kody-os app on Kody. First open the published guide with Kody search entity package:kody-os#.agents/skills/adding-an-app/SKILL.md, then follow that definition contract. Use the package's add_app through the Kody MCP execute wrapper. Validate before writing, verify with list_apps and get_app_state, and do not publish or change the package source. Do not add it to the homepage unless I ask. Ask me before writing if any detail is missing or ambiguous.

– App id: [slug]
– Name: [display name]
– What it does: [one sentence]

The new app appears on the Apps page immediately. Add it to the home dashboard from the App Store row’s Add to home control. Pins, hidden flags, homepage order, and recent use stay on this device.

Setting up a fresh fork or opening the OS for the first time? Follow the setup guide: open the published guide with Kody search entity package:kody-os#docs/setup.md and follow its sequence, ending with your first installed app.
